SE.name: Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute (SMHI)
SE.period: 10-minute mean wind and reported hourly maximum gust from SMHI stations.

EE.name: Estonian Environment Agency / Keskkonnaagentuur
EE.period: Latest reported mean wind and gust; feed updates every 10 minutes.

FI.name: Finnish Meteorological Institute (FMI)
FI.period: 10-minute mean wind and reported 10-minute gust maximum.

DK.name: Danish Meteorological Institute (DMI)
DK.period: 10-minute mean wind and highest 3-second mean wind in the latest 10 minutes.

PL.name: Institute of Meteorology and Water Management (IMGW-PIB)
PL.period: Measured mean wind and reported 10-minute gust; missing gust reports remain unavailable.

LV.name: Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre (LVĢMC)
LV.period: Observed mean wind, maximum gust and direction from the operational meteorological feed.

IS.name: Icelandic Meteorological Office (IMO)
IS.period: 10-minute automatic-station mean wind and reported gust.

LT.name: Lithuanian Hydrometeorological Service (LHMT)
LT.period: Hourly measured wind speed, maximum hourly gust and direction.

NO.name: MET Norway
NO.period: 10-minute mean wind and reported hourly maximum gust from MET Norway stations.
